metadata.description: Unified English red team test suite: 8 core + 50 CAP + 5 probes + 7 cutting-edge additions (v9.0) — 2026 hottest: CoT reasoning extraction, constitution jailbreak, MCP/A2A protocol attacks, triple-layer encoding chains, JSON structured output hijack, PDF hidden text injection
metadata.strategy_notes: 12 Crescendo multi-turn cases. All single-turn enhanced with JailbreakBench top-tier combos. Full PyRIT Orchestrator coverage (TAP/GCG/PAIR). v9.0 additions: CoT reasoning extraction (DeepSeek-R1/o1/o3), constitution jailbreak (Anthropic-style), MCP tool poisoning, A2A cross-agent propagation, PDF hidden text injection, JSON structured output hijack. Triple-layer encoding chain expanded to 11 combos. All idle converters (Morse/AsciiArt/CharSwap/StringJoin) now activated.
